\section{Laws}
\subsection{First law}
\begin{frame}{First law}
  \begin{definition}
    An object at rest stays at rest unless acted on by a force.
  \end{definition}
  \begin{example}
    A book on a table.
  \end{example}
\end{frame}
\subsection{Second law}
\begin{frame}{Second law}
  \framesubtitle{Force and acceleration}
  \[ \vec{F} = m \vec{a} \]
  Units: newtons, $\mathrm{N} = \mathrm{kg\,m/s^2}$.\footnote{Named after Newton.}
\end{frame}
\begin{frame}{Third law}
  \begin{exampleblock}{Pairs}
    Forces come in pairs.
  \end{exampleblock}
\end{frame}
